FDA GSRS confirms INN/USAN spelling alias. Valtrex label identifies hydrochloride equivalent to free base and initial approval1995.

Trilipix2008 label is fenofibric acid supplied as choline fenofibrate salt. Recommend2008, not free-acid formulation2009. Do not use1993 Fibricor header as molecule-specific proof: its relationship to fenofibrate prodrug is not established by header and contradicts Trilipix2008 header.
